assets.name: mossling
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original monster game portrait for the German 3D exploration game Gehstock-Mons, used in collection, encounters and starter cards.
Scene/backdrop: deep dark teal seamless studio backdrop and ground, softly lit, subtle ground contact shadow.
Subject: an adorable squat woodland creature with rich green moss fur, tiny branch antlers with a few tender green leaves, small rounded limbs, and bright amber eyes. It carries a crooked natural wooden walking cane. Soft moss tufts, earthy wood detail, gentle curious expression.
Color palette: emerald and moss greens, warm amber eyes, brown wooden cane.
Style/medium: polished stylized 3D game character render, rounded appealing shapes, toy-like proportions, beautifully detailed tactile surfaces, big expressive eyes, elegant restrained subsurface scattering, family-friendly original character design.
Composition/framing: square 1024x1024 portrait. Exactly one full-body creature centered, front three-quarter view with face toward viewer, cane clearly visible and touching ground. Plenty of margin on every side; entire creature, appendages and cane inside frame. Character occupies about 65 percent of height. Eye-level camera. Clean clear silhouette readable at thumbnail size.
Lighting/mood: soft warm key light from upper left, subtle cool rim light, inviting magical mood, grounded studio lighting.
Constraints: no typography, no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no frame, no other creatures, no extra props; original design with consistent high-end stylized 3D game art treatment.
